fusions.name: Drifting Raft
fusions.desc: Your swarm drifts over every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 6 damage and leaving each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on a target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Unhurried Wallow
fusions.desc: Sets a raft of rats drifting slowly toward one enemy; when it arrives it deals 30 damage, and the hit is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Warm Raft
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Floating Colony

riders.text: and there is always a body to slip behind
and nothing feels urgent out on the water

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground.
